title: Playwright harness — extapp
description: Laconic static gate for apps/extapp. File: apps/extapp/playwright.harness.json. Required Playwright project names: functional, visual. One extension-sized viewport for visual (product popup size) — no visual-mobile / desktop+mobile dual like webapp. playwright.config.ts project `name` values MUST match this list (import or duplicate — keep simple). Narrow integration only: app up, mock externals. No e2e suite names. seo/analytics are out of scope for extensions.

projects.description: Playwright config project names. Must include functional and visual. No *-mobile variants for extapp (popup is one fixed-ish size).

coverage.description: Optional coverage wiring hint. No thresholds yet.
